trigger.decision: Add a paired tmcp-versus-tdev MCP development-path comparison and continuous remediation loop without replacing the existing qualification methods.

sdd.reason: The decision adds a separately falsifiable comparative acceptance method, client/path equivalence boundary, metric families, frozen-manifest rule and feedback gate. It changes verification meaning but introduces no product runtime authority by acceptance alone.

acceptedDecision.owner: D0045 owns comparative qualification meaning only; existing product and runtime owners remain unchanged.
matrix: Codex -> MCP -> tmcp versus Codex -> MCP -> tdev
supported web ChatGPT -> MCP -> tmcp versus supported web ChatGPT -> MCP -> tdev
acceptedDecision.pairing: Comparisons are valid only within one client stratum from the same immutable repository base and equivalent semantic objective, validation and effect bounds.
acceptedDecision.corpus: Frozen deterministic, real-source, legal-parallel, conflicting/dependent and controlled-failure development workloads on isolated candidates/refs.
acceptedDecision.metrics: Correctness/safety, end-to-end latency, throughput, useful parallel overlap, per-success operation/byte/resource/interaction efficiency, stability and recovery remain separately visible.
acceptedDecision.antiCherryPicking: Calibration is non-qualifying; workload, order, repetitions, exclusions, formulas and numeric thresholds freeze before candidate results.
acceptedDecision.improvementLoop: Attribute each failure to the responsible owner, classify and implement the correction under SDD, then rerun the complete frozen corpus rather than only the failed sample.
acceptedDecision.reportBoundary: Small reviewable commits remain required, but user-facing completion is the whole comparative checkpoint PASS or an exact irresolvable authority/external-resource/safety blocker.
acceptedDecision.d0035Relationship: A verified D0045 result may support adoption and D0035 planning but never proves tmcp was disabled or that self-hosting is independent.

unknowns: measured variance and practical noise floor per client/runtime profile
numeric material-improvement thresholds to freeze after calibration and before candidate trials
next: Keep D0044 as the current selected gate. After the current route reaches an authorized scheduling boundary and D0042/D0043 plus D0023/D0024 prerequisites exist, route D0045 explicitly before implementing or executing its comparator.
